description: Replace dynamic imports in session.test.ts with static import for faster module resolution

asi.hypothesis: Replace unnecessary dynamic await import('./session') inside tests with static top-level import. vi.mock hoisting ensures mocks are established before static imports resolve.
asi.insight: session.test.ts dropped from ~1087ms to 3ms - the dynamic imports forced module re-fetching per test case instead of using cached mock

description: Remove unused connectionSchema and zod import from connection-wizard.tsx dead code
